objective: A shared decision-contract optimizer that transfers across checkpoint families and changing traffic; adding model-name patches is not generality.
selection_policy: 10 selected checkpoints including original five; JEV 9B and 27B count as one family. Record architecture and head-contract coverage separately. Preserve unsupported, failed and fallback-only cases in cohort accounting.
initial_scope: Text decisions on single NVIDIA GPUs. Multimodal, quantized and cross-vendor acceleration remain separate research questions.

candidate_method.adapter: Released encoding, execution boundary, attention and padding semantics, head readout, calibration, literal answer conversion and backend capabilities. No model-specific optimization branches.
constraints: Verify padding, recurrence metadata and option-marker semantics
Own buffers and tensor lifetimes explicitly
Treat fatal CUDA errors as worker failure
Fallback is reported compatibility, not successful acceleration

baselines: Released native implementation with documented optional kernels
Released optimized or compiled path when supported
Recommended native serving backend with batching and scheduling enabled where contract-compatible
holdout: Source review allowed before freeze; no reserved-family timing or policy tuning before shared optimizer code, adapter specification, profiling budget and evaluation traces are frozen.

required_fields: usage and unsupported behavior when applicable
native_conformance.quality: Ground-truth task accuracy and calibration are separate from equivalence to the released path.
native_conformance.numeric_tolerances: Contract-specific tolerances and threshold grid must be frozen before optimized evaluation; strict label and routing-policy agreement assessed separately.

resident_design.order: Randomized paired mode and workload order; retain worker, source and hardware identities.
resident_design.analysis_unit: Worker round, not individual calls; report conditional attrition and all failed attempts.

serving_design.pilot: Estimate feasible offered loads with separately archived pilot traces; freeze rates before confirmatory runs.
serving_design.comparison: Paired trace and offered load; randomized mode order, fresh workers and explicit cache history.

cost: Include startup, admission, serving and idle resource time; reconcile available billed usage separately from resource-rate estimates. No estimate described as an observed invoice saving.
execution: One study GPU across all applications; wait for prior worker retirement; leave existing deployed applications untouched.
gates: Native contract conformance and component profiling for additional candidates
Implement shared optimizer on development families
Freeze shared method and confirmatory design
Evaluate reserved families without model-specific optimization edits
Longer serving tests for conforming candidates
Reconcile per-contract performance, fidelity, coverage and cost before revising manuscript claims
generality_claim: Requires measured acceleration with acceptable fidelity on reserved contract families and predeclared serving traces, plus explicit overall accelerated coverage and regression outcomes. Native fallback everywhere cannot pass.
novelty: Distinguish decision-contract-specific analysis and transferable transformations from existing graph compilation, batching and cost-guided selection.
next_gate: Native contract conformance and profiling; source audits contain no GPU performance results.
